title: Measure what a report-only Conditional Access policy would block
summary: Count report-only results per policy and user, so you know who would fail or be interrupted before you switch a policy to On.
code:
// Interactive sign-ins; ConditionalAccessPolicies is a dynamic column in SigninLogs
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| mv-expand CAP = ConditionalAccessPolicies
| extend Policy = tostring(CAP.displayName), Result = tostring(CAP.result)
| where Result in ("reportOnlyFailure", "reportOnlyInterrupted")
| summarize SignIns = count(), Users = dcount(UserPrincipalName), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10)
    by Policy, Result
| order by SignIns desc
notes: reportOnlyFailure means the policy would have blocked the sign-in; reportOnlyInterrupted means the user would have been asked for something (for example MFA) they didn't complete.
Replace the summarize line with 'by Policy, Result, UserPrincipalName' to get the user list for one policy.
